title: Micron announced Research Labs and related research investment
canonical_summary: Micron announced a new research-lab investment anchored in Boise and described related research and training investment, establishing a long-term technology and capacity-development milestone.
known_event_summary: August 27-28, 2026 Micron Research Labs announcement: Micron introduced a Boise-anchored research-lab program with a planned investment of about $10 billion over the next decade.

facts.proposition: Micron announced Micron Research Labs and a new approximately $10 billion U.S. research investment.
Micron Technology has made recent investments in research and training facilities in Boise.
Micron planned approximately $10 billion of new research-lab investment over the next decade.
